title: Core encoded condition
statement: Let $d$ be a data structure, and let $x,U,t,e$ be finite Boolean strings. The predicate $	ext{Core}(x,U,t,e)$ holds if the first component obtained by taking the first component of the first component of $t$ has length $M_1(x)$, and either $	ext{SoundFail}$ holds for $x,U$ and the four components of $t$ obtained by the nested first and second projections, or $	ext{Match}$ fails for $x,U$ with that same first-first component and the two components of $e$.
caveat: The meanings of the component projections, $M_1$, $	ext{SoundFail}$, and $	ext{Match}$ are not supplied, so this states their formal relationships without interpreting them.
